executive_summary: This week, key themes in corporate cash management for CEE include the accelerating adoption of ISO 20022 for cross-border payments and the growing demand for real-time liquidity management through instant payments. The landscape for Open Banking APIs in corporate treasury is also rapidly evolving, with new standardization discussions emerging for deeper integration. A significant competitor move saw Erste Group Bank launch an enhanced API-driven instant payment solution for large corporate clients, directly challenging CMIplus's offerings. The most urgent action for CMIplus is to immediately assess and enhance its instant payment capabilities and API integration strategy to maintain competitive advantage and address this direct market challenge. Philipp Höfer should prioritize a review of our current instant payment roadmap and API integration strategy to ensure CMIplus remains at the forefront of innovation.
